{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Cold Release}}''' - Upon death, the '''Frostbane''' spawns ten [[Frostmite]]s. }} ==Description== The '''Frostbane''', internally referred to as '''Elite Snow Golem''' and previously known as the '''Permafrost''', is an enemy that appears in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It has a decently high amount of health, an average speed and [[Stun Immunity]]. Upon death, the '''Frostbane''' spawns in ten [[Frostmite]]s. ==Appearance== The '''Frostbane''' is a giant creature made out of ice. It has a white head, upper torso and upper arms, while its legs, lower arms and lower torso are blue. On its torso, it has a neon blue crystal. Multiple spikes come out of its body. ==Strategy== *The '''Frostbane''' could potentially pose a threat due to it's high health and ability to spawn [[Frostmite]]s upon death. **Decent mid-game or any high damage dealing towers like the [[Enforcer]], [[Kingpin]] and [[Engineer]] are able to deal with '''Frostbane''' with barely any issues. *The '''Frostbane''' often spawns in hordes and on death summons in swarms of [[Frostmite]]s. Because of this, AOE towers like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Demoman]] can be used. **The [[Hacker]] could also be used to lower the amount of [[Frostmite]]s spawned to 1. **Towers that also stun multiple enemies such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]] or [[Tesla]] can also be useful at dealing with the [[Frostmite]]s spawned. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePermafrost.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Frostbane''' on a promotional video. Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Frostbane''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} PermafrostIconIG.png|'''Frostbane''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was originally made for the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], though it went unused until the release of the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. *It is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *Originally, on the release of [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, '''Frostbane''' used to be called ''Permafrost''. ==Update History== *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Permafrost''' added. **{{Bug}} Has no animations in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} '''Permafrost's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''19 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0|v1.82.2]]a **{{Bugfix}} Now has animations in the [[Index]]. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health increased from 500 to 650. **Speed increased from 3.5 to 3.75. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]] **Name changed from ''Permafrost'' to ''Frostbane''. **Health increased from 650 to 3,200 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. **Speed decreased from Above Average (3.75) to Average (3.2). **Cash given changed from {{Money|800}} on death to {{Money|792}} every 33% health. **''Cold Release'' number of [[Frostmite]]s spawned increased from 3 to 10. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **Size increased. {{FrostMode|[[Frost Hunter]]|Wave 25|Frostbane|Wave 26|[[Frost Ravager]]|Wave 28}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
